newsitem.title: USA: Brooks Fiber expands deal with MCI.
newsitem.headline: Brooks Fiber expands deal with MCI.

text.p: Brooks Fiber Properties Inc, which provides local telecommunications services, said Thursday it significantly expanded its existing contractual relationship with MCI Communications Corp.

Under the agreement, Brooks will be MCI's preferred local service provider in 17 more cities, bringing the total number of cities to 35. MCI has agreed to use Brooks' networks for its dedicated access business, thereby providing Brooks with a significant core revenue stream, the company said.
Brooks said the companies are also working together to strengthen service offerings to local customers.
